added_models.model: Rat collagen-induced arthritis, therapeutic dosing from peak disease (lanraplenib/GS-9876)

engagement.model: Rat collagen-induced arthritis, therapeutic dosing from peak disease (lanraplenib/GS-9876)
engagement.confidence_note: ACR 2016 meeting abstract (Arthritis Rheumatol 68 suppl 10), no DOI/PMID; tier 1 assigned provisionally as the draft does for the MK-8457 ACR abstracts (open rule question). Gilead never published the rat CIA study in full.
engagement.note: Rat readouts were ankle swelling, paw weight, histopathology, anti-CII antibody and joint RNA/protein; none was carried into humans.
engagement.short: Joint readouts only, no human PD
engagement.quote: Efficacy evaluations were based on animal body weights, daily ankle caliper measurements, ankle diameter (expressed as area under the curve), terminal hind paw weights, and histopathology of ankles and knees.
engagement.judgement: The Phase 2 (Kivitz 2018) measured VectraDA and TruCulture whole-blood stimulation, neither a readout the rat model used, so the model's PD was never tested in humans; the cell stays untested.
engagement.reason: No shared PD readout in humans

dose.model: Rat collagen-induced arthritis, therapeutic dosing from peak disease (lanraplenib/GS-9876)
dose.confidence_note: ACR 2016 meeting abstract (Arthritis Rheumatol 68 suppl 10), no DOI/PMID; tier 1 assigned provisionally as the draft does for the MK-8457 ACR abstracts (open rule question). Gilead never published the rat CIA study in full.
dose.note: Sponsor states rat efficacious exposures match those in healthy volunteers (Dolton 2016 FIH); the exposure target was reached before efficacy was known.
dose.quote: PK analysis of GS-9876 showed serum exposure levels similar to those achieved in human studies.
dose.judgement: Opening entry; the abstract itself puts rat and human exposure side by side, but efficacy was unknown in 2016 so no dose status can be set yet. No tolerability margin is stated for the rat.

dose.model: Rat collagen-induced arthritis, therapeutic dosing from peak disease (lanraplenib/GS-9876)
dose.note: Patient exposure matched the HV exposure the rat was dosed to, DAS28-CRP did not move, and Gilead ran no further RA trial.
dose.short: Target reached, DAS28 unmoved, RA dropped
dose.quote: Plasma exposures of all study drugs were comparable to those observed in healthy subjects and historical data.
dose.magnitude_basis: exposure only stated as 'similar' between rat and human; no numbers in either abstract
dose.confidence_note: Exposure match is qualitative in both abstracts (rat 'similar to' human; patient 'comparable to' HV). Registry NCT02885181 results posted 2018-09-19 set the date; ACR 2018 abstract has no DOI/PMID (tier 1 provisional).
dose.judgement: Table row 'reached, failed, abandoned': the rat's effective exposure was reached in RA patients (30 mg QD) and the primary endpoint failed, so dose is contra derived from efficacy, counted once. Lanraplenib continued only in lupus/Sjogren's and later AML, never again in RA.

efficacy.model: Rat collagen-induced arthritis, therapeutic dosing from peak disease (lanraplenib/GS-9876)
efficacy.confidence_note: ACR 2016 meeting abstract (Arthritis Rheumatol 68 suppl 10), no DOI/PMID; tier 1 assigned provisionally as the draft does for the MK-8457 ACR abstracts (open rule question). Gilead never published the rat CIA study in full.
efficacy.note: Therapeutic rat CIA (dosed from peak disease, day 17-20 to 34): dose-responsive efficacy on swelling, paw weight and histology; Gilead's RA entry model.
efficacy.quote: GS-9876 demonstrated dose-responsive efficacy in the rat CIA model.
efficacy.judgement: Opening at first public use (ACR 2016, after NCT02885181 started 2016-09). Dolton 2016 (FIH abstract) confirms the rat CIA model was the in vivo efficacy basis for the RA program, so this is lanraplenib's own disease-model track, distinct from the MK-8457 rat AIA/CIA track.

efficacy.model: Rat collagen-induced arthritis, therapeutic dosing from peak disease (lanraplenib/GS-9876)
efficacy.note: MTX/biologic-IR RA, 12 weeks on MTX: DAS28-CRP change -1.26 (30 mg) and -0.78 (10 mg) vs -1.36 placebo; filgotinib comparator -2.46 worked.
efficacy.quote: Clinical efficacy of GS-9876 in RA was not observed, but GS-9876 was safe and well-tolerated over a 12 week period in patients with active RA on MTX.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: DAS28-CRP LS-mean difference vs placebo at week 12: +0.01 at 30 mg (p=0.978), +0.40 at 10 mg (p=0.300)
efficacy.confidence_note: Registry record NCT02885181 (tier 3, results posted 2018-09-19) carries the same numbers and corroborates the ACR 2018 abstract, which has no DOI/PMID (tier 1 provisional, same rule question as the draft's MK-8457 sources). Abstract-level reading.

patient_trials.quote: Change From Baseline in DAS28 (CRP) at Week 12: GS-9876 30 mg -1.26, GS-9876 10 mg -0.78, filgotinib -2.46, placebo -1.36; LS mean difference vs placebo 0.01 (p=0.978) and 0.40 (p=0.300).

efficacy.judgement: Paired by me: the rat model predicted efficacy at exposures the trial reached, and the primary endpoint did not separate from placebo while the filgotinib arm validated the trial. Not neg: the rat data showed dose-responsive efficacy, not a below-bar signal. This corrects the draft's note that lanraplenib had only a lupus model published.
efficacy.reason: Rat CIA cleared; patients did not improve

safety.model: Rat collagen-induced arthritis, therapeutic dosing from peak disease (lanraplenib/GS-9876)
safety.confidence_note: ACR 2016 meeting abstract (Arthritis Rheumatol 68 suppl 10), no DOI/PMID; tier 1 assigned provisionally as the draft does for the MK-8457 ACR abstracts (open rule question). Gilead never published the rat CIA study in full.
safety.note: Abstract reports efficacy only; no tolerability, infection or bleeding readout from the rat.
safety.quote: GS-9876 is a novel SYK inhibitor which displays in vivo therapeutic efficacy in a chronic rat CIA model.
safety.judgement: The rat made no safety prediction. Kivitz 2018 reported no deaths or serious AE over 12 weeks, so the model's silence was never contradicted; with no harm to compare, the cell stays untested rather than same. Bleeding is scored on the existing cynomolgus track.
safety.reason: No harm appeared to test silence

considered_not_added: NZB/W F1 lupus mouse, lanraplenib (Blomgren 2020 10.1021/acsmedchemlett.9b00621; Pohlmeyer 2021 10.1186/s41927-021-00178-3): cross-indication lupus model dosed 'to mimic the human clinical target coverage range'; predicts lupus, not RA, so no RA patient comparison; belongs to a lupus tile
NZB/W F1 lupus mouse, cevidoplenib (CEI 2022 10.1093/cei/uxac096): same, a lupus prediction; the paper's RA model (K/BxN) is already tracked
Primary human B cells from healthy donors and SLE patients, lanraplenib (Pohlmeyer 2021): in vitro CD69/BAFF potency assay (EC50 298 vs 340 nM); SLE donors, no RA patient-level comparison

Human whole-blood anti-FcepsilonR1 basophil CD63 assay, lanraplenib (Blomgren 2020 Table 4): in vitro potency screen used to set target coverage; no CD63 readout reported in dosed humans for lanraplenib, and the Phase 2 PD (TruCulture, VectraDA) is a different assay, so nothing to compare

Ex vivo GPVI platelet aggregation in dosed monkeys and humans / healthy-volunteer bleeding time (Clarke 2018; Dolton 2016 'No clinically relevant changes in bleeding time'): same system as the existing cynomolgus-bleeding-time-lanraplenib track (checker lead 1 is an engagement entry on that track, not a new model)
Quantitative framework for filgotinib + GS-9876 combination in rat CIA (ACR abstract, not scraped): the combination was never dosed in RA patients, so no comparison
Entospletinib in K/BxN (Kaposztas 2023 10.3389/fimmu.2023.1279155): non-member sibling, already noted by the draft
Fostamatinib/R406 on RA patient synovial cells and fostamatinib Phase 3 data: non-member, not scored

Patient-derived organoids/cells, PDX co-clinical, human challenge, human genetic (SYK loss-of-function) and in-silico/QSP dose-selection models: none found for cevidoplenib, lanraplenib or MK-8457; the GS-9876 FIH abstract reports empirical PK only
Cevidoplenib Phase 1 HV studies NCT02717988 and NCT03315494: no results posted and no PD paper found; nothing to compare
MK-8457: no model system beyond the tracked rat AIA/CIA found (Merck published nothing further)
